evidence.title: GitHub - bluzky/salad_ui: Phoenix Liveview component library inspired by shadcn UI

name: SaladUI
summary: Phoenix LiveView component library inspired by shadcn/ui, usable as a package or copied in as editable code.
description: A component library for Phoenix LiveView (Elixir) inspired by shadcn/ui. Add saladui to mix.exs and run mix salad.setup to use the components straight from the library, or mix salad.install to copy every component and JavaScript file into lib/<app>_web/components/ui for full customization and custom module prefixes. v1 ships 32 components, from accordion, alert dialog and avatar to table, tabs, textarea and tooltip; a storybook demo runs at salad-storybook.fly.dev. MIT licensed.
contains: install modes: mix salad.setup (library) or mix salad.install (local copy)
command, table, tabs and pagination shipped in v1
not available yet: carousel, combobox, context menu, drawer, input OTP
